why: मन्मन् is the regular endingless Vedic locative of मन्मन्; sense 'in his thought' fits.
वहन्तु is 3pl imperative of वह् with plural subject अश्वाः; correct.
वहसि is 2sg present of वह्, agreeing with 2sg राजसि; correct.
पृथिव्यै is the dative parallel to दिवे and प्रजायै; the trailing ५ is the edition's own number.
मन्मनि is the regular locative of मन्मन्; ३ after अपीच्ये is a svara digit, not an error.
वहतु is 3sg imperative with subject अयम् जातवेदाः; correct.
राजामि 'I rule' is 1sg present, matching the first-person speech of Varuna (अहं राजा in the next line).
राजानः is nominative plural of राजन्, with the plural धुः; correct.
द्विषम् is accusative of द्विष्, object of सृजत; correct.
वचसे is the dative of वचस्, agreeing with सोम्याय; correct.
वचसः is the genitive of वचस् governed by गोपाः; correct.
वचसी is the dual nominative of वचस्, matching dual पस्पृधाते; correct.
महिषः 'buffalo' is a regular nominative epithet of Soma; correct.
महिषं is the accusative of महिष, object of अभरत्; correct.
वाजेभिः is the Vedic instrumental plural, parallel to राया and इषा; correct.
देवयुं is the accusative of देवयु, parallel to ब्रह्मप्रियं; correct.
पुरोषा is the sandhi of पुरा + उषाः; correct.
भुवनात् is the ablative after पासि, parallel to विश्वस्मात् and असुर्यात्; correct.
पुरोत is पुरा + उत in sandhi, mirroring मोत earlier in the line; correct.
देवजाः 'god-born' is a regular compound nominative plural; correct.
वाजेन is the instrumental singular of वाज; correct.
सूर्येणा shows metrical lengthening of the instrumental ending, usual in the Samhita; correct.
देवयु with dropped final visarga before the pada end is the edition's form; nominative of देवयु; correct.
पवमानाः is nominative plural, agreeing with अपघ्नन्तः and सीदत; correct.
पुरोतो is पुरा + उतो in sandhi; correct.
ओजसः is the ablative parallel to बलात् and सहसः; correct.
वसुनः is the genitive of वसु governed by विभागे; correct.
नरमा is नरम् + आ (preverb of करामहे) in sandhi; correct.
मदता is 2pl imperative of मद्, agreeing with vocative मनीषिणः; correct.
मदन्तः is nominative plural participle agreeing with इषयेम देवाः; correct.
उषसा is the dual nominative with dual वाजयन्ती and दुरोणे…तस्थतुः; svarita on सा is right before anudatta वा.
मदन्ती is the dual nominative participle, agreeing with dual विघृते; correct.
मदन्तः is the nominative plural participle, agreeing with अनमीवासः; correct.
पृथिव्याम् is the locative, parallel to दिवि; correct.
उत्तरो is उत्तरः with visarga sandhi before बभूवान्; correct.
वृत्रघ्न is the regular vocative of वृत्रहन्; correct.
नरस्त्वां is नरः + त्वाम् in sandhi; correct.
वदे is 1sg middle 'I talk with', matching 1sg भुवानि; the ३ after तन्वा is a svara digit.
नरस्ते is नरः + ते in sandhi; correct.
मदथः is 2nd dual present, fitting the Ashvin dual address; correct.
वृत्रघ्नः is the genitive of वृत्रहन्; correct.
वृत्रघ्ने is the dative of वृत्रहन्, parallel to इन्द्राय and नरे; correct.
पृथिव्यास्ते is पृथिव्याः + ते in sandhi; correct.
नामधाः 'name-giver' is a regular nominative compound; correct.
मदन्तीः is the feminine nominative plural participle, agreeing with ताः; correct.
उत्तरं is the accusative agreeing with सुम्नम्; correct.
पिबन्ता is the dual nominative participle, matching dual सचेथे; correct.
ब्रह्मणा is the instrumental of ब्रह्मन्; correct.
पिबन्तः is the nominative plural participle, agreeing with वहन्ते/दधिरे; correct.
सजोषस्त्वा is सजोषः + त्वा in sandhi; correct.
गृणतः is the genitive of the participle गृणत्, governed by हवम्; correct.
पिबन्तीः is the feminine plural participle, agreeing with प्रजावतीः; correct.
पुनर्नो is पुनः + नः in sandhi; correct.
पिबतः is 3rd dual present, matching the dual Ashvins; correct.
धामनि is the locative of धामन्, agreeing with प्रिये; correct.
हवस्य is the genitive of हव governed by बोधतं; correct.
धामनी is the dual nominative of धामन्, matching dual प्रतीची and तस्थतुः; correct.
पुनर्न is पुनः + नः in sandhi; correct.
पुनर्दुः is पुनः + दुः in sandhi; correct.
सवितुः is the genitive of सवितृ, parallel to देवस्य; correct.
